title: Pontchartrain Records and Chris Kenner
summary: He ran Pontchartrain, lost his copies, arranged Don't Make No Noise.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

Oh yeah. I recorded with my band.
I recorded with my band.

Mm-hmm.
